Pilot · United States

Jeffrey Skiles

US Airways Flight 15492009
Flight
US Airways Flight 1549
Date
15 January 2009
Aircraft
Airbus A320
Location
Hudson River, New York
Survivors
155 of 155 aboard

First officer on the 'Miracle on the Hudson'. He worked through the engine-restart checklist while the captain flew the glide to the river. All 155 aboard survived.

Who helped

Besides Jeffrey Skiles, 10 people helped on US Airways Flight 1549. What each of them did, with sources, is on Chesley "Sully" Sullenberger's page.

  • Chesley "Sully" Sullenberger Captain
  • Doreen Welsh Flight attendant
  • Sheila Dail Flight attendant
  • Donna Dent Flight attendant
  • Vincent Lombardi Ferry captain (NY Waterway, Thomas Jefferson)
  • Brittany Catanzaro Ferry captain (NY Waterway, Governor Thomas H. Kean)
  • Vincent Lucante Ferry port captain (NY Waterway, Yogi Berra)
  • Michael Delaney NYPD Harbor Unit scuba diver
  • Robert Rodriguez NYPD Harbor Unit scuba diver
  • Patrick Harten Air traffic controller (New York TRACON)

Source: en.wikipedia.org/wiki/US_Airways_Flight_1549 ↗
